en: Black‑and‑white studio photograph showing a woman in a long white dress dancing or twirling with her back to the camera while a uniformed soldier in a tunic, tall cap, and sidearm stands behind a rustic wooden fence, tipping his hat toward her. The backdrop is a painted pastoral landscape with foliage and a path. Some handwritten characters appear inverted along the lower edge of the image, as if from a caption on the negative.
